p.title: A source push that fixed the data plane failed CI only because time had passed, so no release could be attested
p.symptom: 11-04: 432ac3eb (the fix for the stopped data plane) failed its push CI on data-lineage and data-refresh (data.json 13.6 h > 12 h SLA, because the data plane had been stopped) and knowledge-lint (CODE-MAP last_verified 46 d > 45 d). Reduced-scope data releases need a successful full push CI on their source commit, so 9da5c8ba (fresh data 02:54Z) and every later data commit failed attestation; rerunning 432ac3eb's CI could never pass. Live stayed at v59.68.
p.root_cause: Source-push CI blocked on calendar facts (data age, document age) that no code change on that commit could fix, and the attest guard made the data plane depend on that CI. The refresh-origin ADVISORY (record 07) covered data commits only.
p.fix: Every ci.yml contract shard runs with AIO_QA_ORIGIN=ci, source pushes included: liveData: content gates report ADVISORY and knowledge-lint reports its P1125 date ratchet as a warning (scripts/lib/qa-live-data.mjs clockJudgementBlocks). Producer pre-push runs, local runs and the watchdog twins (watchdog-data-lineage, watchdog-scenario-guidance, watchdog-data-refresh, new watchdog-knowledge-lint) still fail. Source-defect gates declare nothing and block everywhere. RULES R634 and governance-markers record the scope.
p.violated_rule: R634 (rewritten v59.70): calendar facts block producers and the watchdog, not source-push CI
p.prevention: {R}: scripts/ci-refresh-origin-live-data-check.mjs checks every gate x {source, ci}, the source-defect gates (workflow-yaml, syntax, generated-state, qa-pipeline-contract, workspace-contract, knowledge-lint) staying blocking, the 432ac3eb deadlock rows, the ci.yml wiring (one AIO_QA_ORIGIN: ci, none in producer/watchdog/pages workflows), real qa-runner replays (live old=red, new=green in CI, red locally; source defect red in CI) and a real knowledge-lint calendar replay 300 days on (red outside CI, green in CI with the warning). It fails with the HEAD lib/ci.yml/knowledge-lint/manifest.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-refresh-origin-live-data-check.mjs OK (184 gates x 2 origins, 12 ledger causes).

r.title: Calendar facts fail producers and the watchdog, not CI contract shards
r.rule: ci.yml contract shards set AIO_QA_ORIGIN=ci; there a liveData: content gate reports ADVISORY and a wall-clock document-date judgement warns. Each has a watchdog-local twin that still fails. No other workflow sets AIO_QA_ORIGIN. Gates that judge code never declare liveData.

qa.text: v59.70: a source push whose tree carries stale data or a document past 45 days passes CI with ADVISORY/warning lines, and data-watchdog still fails watchdog-data-lineage / watchdog-knowledge-lint in that state

changelog: **CI no longer deadlocks on the clock (v59.70, {P}/{R}):** data age and document dates now fail only the data producers and the watchdog; in CI, source pushes included, they are reported, so a fix push is not held red by time alone. Code defects still block CI.
note: Supersedes the refresh-origin-only scope of record 07 (same gate, extended to every CI contract shard)
